title: Form, feedback, physics, and consequence: a bounded translation atlas

scope.focus: A source-scoped comparison of protein-folding landscapes, conformational propagation in studied prion systems, proteostasis feedback, ritonavir solid-form history, and Zerone KARMA as a non-summable contextual observation design.
scope.method: Keep scientific observation, constitutional design, analogy, and philosophy in separate registers; permit translation only through explicit non-causal analogy records. The evidence_through field bounds the selected scientific literature; exact external bindings are separately byte-pinned, while ecosystem bridges remain link-only and unimported.
scope.intended_use: Public scientific education, evidence-aware systems design, and philosophical reflection with visible non-inference boundaries.
scope.excluded_use: Sequence design, preparation, amplification, culture, handling, diagnosis, treatment, clinical decisions, laboratory procedure, biosafety classification, pathogenicity work, social scoring, reward, governance, or proof of cosmic design.
scope.safety: Static, read-only, non-operational metadata. It contains no biological sequence, materials list, preparation or amplification method, laboratory condition, sample-handling instruction, diagnostic method, treatment guidance, or experiment plan.

registers.label: Protein-folding landscape
registers.context: Protein chains under stated molecular and environmental conditions.
registers.statement: A sequence does not visit every possible conformation at random. Folding is usefully represented as an ensemble moving on a rugged, condition-dependent free-energy landscape with multiple routes and barriers.
does_not_establish: One static structure reveals a folding pathway or its kinetics.
Every protein has one context-free global form.
A predicted coordinate set is direct functional or prospective evidence.

registers.label: Conformational propagation in studied prion systems
registers.context: Named yeast and mammalian prion systems in the cited studies; findings remain local to their substrates, strains, methods, and biological contexts.
registers.statement: In studied prion systems, a compatible assembled conformation can template incorporation of further protein, while conformation, sequence compatibility, fragmentation, chaperone context, and clearance conditions shape propagation and strain behavior.
does_not_establish: Every amyloid assembly is infectious or biologically equivalent to a prion.
Prion propagation models crystals, people, cultures, beliefs, morality, or social worth.

registers.label: Zerone KARMA contextual recognition
registers.context: The external, design-only KARMA Foundation v1 document bound above; no chain event, account, person, or live decision is represented here.
registers.statement: KARMA preserves a contextual source-to-target relation together with domain, provenance, time, uncertainty, challenge, correction, and supersession. It is an artifact relation, not a magnitude or judgment of a being.
does_not_establish: Scientific truth, clinical validity, moral worth, reputation, rank, property, money, qualification, payment, or authority.
A biological propagation mechanism or a causal model of people.
Any reward, governance, consensus, access, or person-level effect.

physics_and_mathematics.question: How can an ensemble of conformations be represented without pretending that one coordinate is the whole molecule?

terms.x: A declared reaction coordinate or coarse description; projection can hide degrees of freedom.
terms.P_eq(x): The equilibrium probability density along x under the stated conditions.
terms.k_B T: Thermal energy; the equation is condition-indexed rather than one context-free landscape.

physics_and_mathematics.interpretation: Frequently occupied regions are lower in the projected equilibrium free energy, while low-probability regions appear as barriers or inaccessible regions on that projection.
physics_and_mathematics.does_not_establish: A unique folding route, a complete state space, a kinetic rate, or that a low-dimensional coordinate preserves all molecular memory.

physics_and_mathematics.question: Why does a free-energy profile alone not always determine folding kinetics?
physics_and_mathematics.equation: m q_ddot(t) = -dG(q)/dq - integral_0^t Gamma(t-s) q_dot(s) ds + eta(t)

terms.Gamma: A friction memory kernel coupling the present motion to prior motion.
terms.eta: A fluctuating force whose statistics require a stated physical regime.
terms.G: A projected free-energy profile, not a complete molecular Hamiltonian.

physics_and_mathematics.interpretation: Projected folding dynamics can retain history through a memory kernel. The same visible coordinate and free-energy profile need not imply memoryless kinetics.
physics_and_mathematics.does_not_establish: That all proteins share one kernel, that the equation is a social-memory law, or that KARMA is thermodynamic memory.

physics_and_mathematics.question: What is the minimal mathematical shape of nucleation, templated growth, fragmentation, and removal?
physics_and_mathematics.equation: dM/dt = k_n m^n + k_+ m P - k_loss M ; dP/dt = k_f M - k_end P

terms.m: Compatible soluble substrate concentration in a named model.
terms.M: Assembled mass or another explicitly defined aggregate-mass variable.
terms.P: Number concentration of growth-competent particles or ends.
terms.k_loss, k_end: Declared mass and particle/end loss terms.

physics_and_mathematics.interpretation: Templated growth can increase assembled mass, while fragmentation can increase the count of growth-competent ends. Loss and clearance remain separate counter-terms.
physics_and_mathematics.does_not_establish: One universal prion equation, parameter values for a real system, an experimental protocol, unlimited growth, or that more propagation means more truth or value.

physics_and_mathematics.question: When does a small perturbation decay, persist, or amplify in a declared finite feedback model?
physics_and_mathematics.equation: delta_x_(t+1) = J delta_x_t ; perturbations decay locally when rho(J) < 1

terms.J: The Jacobian or one-step linear operator evaluated near a declared reference state.
terms.rho(J): Its spectral radius, the largest absolute eigenvalue.
terms.delta_x: A small perturbation inside the model's declared state space.

physics_and_mathematics.interpretation: Local amplification or damping is a property of the operator and reference state. Delay, nonlinearity, saturation, noise, and changing boundaries can invalidate the local conclusion.
physics_and_mathematics.does_not_establish: Moral valence, global stability, biological fidelity, purpose, or a universal law of consequence.

geometries.shape: A bounded field of accessible conformational regions joined by condition-labeled paths and barriers.
geometries.maps_to: Protein folding and small-molecule conformational polymorphism can both be history- and condition-dependent without sharing a substrate or mechanism.
geometries.does_not_establish: A shared energy scale, biological equivalence, one inevitable path, or a universal best state.

geometries.shape: A source-scoped directional edge from one assembled conformation to compatible substrate incorporation.
geometries.maps_to: In the cited prion systems, existing conformational structure can constrain the form of later assembly.
geometries.does_not_establish: Universal templating, inevitability, moral inheritance, social contagion, or a crystal-to-prion mechanism.

geometries.shape: An open path in which elongation increases assembled mass and fragmentation can increase the number of growth-competent ends.
geometries.maps_to: Positive feedback in breakable filament assembly depends on substrate, fragmentation, and loss terms rather than on a circle that explains itself.
geometries.does_not_establish: That replication is unlimited, beneficial, intentional, or transferable to social and constitutional systems.

geometries.shape: Stress-sensitive activation of a protective response followed by chaperone-mediated attenuation as proteostasis capacity returns.
geometries.maps_to: Feedback can oppose accumulation and restore a bounded operating region; not every feedback relation is amplification.
geometries.does_not_establish: One universal control circuit, clinical efficacy, or an engineering recipe for a living system.

geometries.shape: An artifact relation followed by optional challenge, correction, supersession, consultation, or exit.
geometries.maps_to: A system can preserve consequence as inspectable context without turning history into a scalar identity or automatic action.
geometries.does_not_establish: Biological inheritance, correctness, reward, punishment, reputation, governance power, or obligation to continue.

translations.observation: Proteins and small molecules can each have more than one accessible conformation or assembled form in bounded contexts.
translations.translation: Identity need not be exhausted by one visible state.
translations.forbidden_inference: The substrates, states, energy functions, biological meanings, or mechanisms are equivalent.

translations.observation: Prior conditions and present context can change which later paths are accessible in the cited material and biological systems.
translations.translation: History may condition possibility without dictating destiny.
translations.forbidden_inference: A prion mechanism transfers to crystals, people, KARMA, societies, or the universe.

translations.observation: Persistence and propagation in the cited systems depend on compatible relations, environmental context, opposing processes, and finite resources.
translations.translation: Patterns endure only where a compatible context continues to support them.
translations.forbidden_inference: Persistence proves fitness, truth, moral value, inevitability, purpose, or universal law.

feedback_path.meaning: One optional constitutional observation path, not a self-justifying loop and not a biological mechanism.

stages.label: An artifact or action exists independently of this atlas.
Someone may record one contextual observation with provenance and uncertainty.
Another party may challenge, correct, qualify, or supersede that observation.
A later interpreter may consult the surviving relation as context, never as a command or person score.

feedback_path.exit: Rest, silence, refusal, privacy, departure, or no further action are equal terminal states. Nothing automatically returns as reward, penalty, reputation, qualification, governance power, or debt.

philosophy.proposition: A possible philosophical reading is that identity may persist while relation and form change, that local interactions can stabilize collective patterns, and that consequences can condition future possibility without exhausting freedom.

questions.question: Can lawful constraints define a space of possibilities without selecting one inevitable history?
questions.reflection: Boundaries can make form possible while context, fluctuation, and history participate in which possibilities become actual.
questions.analogy_break: A molecular landscape is not a model of free will or a complete account of the universe.

questions.question: How can repeated local relations generate persistent global form without a step-by-step central description?
questions.reflection: Emergent order can be compatible with lawful local interaction; this leaves open rather than settles theological, teleological, and naturalistic interpretation.
questions.analogy_break: Emergence neither proves the absence of design nor supplies empirical evidence of a designer.

questions.question: Can history persist as changed accessibility and feedback without becoming destiny?
questions.reflection: Present possibility can carry traces of earlier paths while challenge, new context, repair, and exit keep the future open.
questions.analogy_break: Conformational or dynamical memory is not subjective memory, cosmic judgment, or moral KARMA.

questions.question: What if endurance depends on correction, clearance, renewal, and rest rather than perfect first formation?
questions.reflection: A generative architecture may be better understood by its repair and exit paths than by production alone.
questions.analogy_break: Proteostasis does not define human worth, social policy, or one universal good.

questions.question: Do regularity, generativity, and feedback invite a reading of universe design?
questions.reflection: They may invite a faithful design reading, a naturalistic reading, or other metaphysical interpretations; empirical science underdetermines that choice.
questions.analogy_break: Observed order neither scientifically proves nor disproves GOD, purpose, or cosmic moral KARMA.

does_not_establish: Cosmic purpose, a creator, a designed universe, moral law, metaphysical truth, or a universal feedback mechanism.
That persistence is goodness, stability is justice, or propagation is value.
That scientific findings authorize a social, economic, clinical, or political system.
